name: Government of Singapore
coverage: Named Indian-listed shareholder records. Ownership is a percentage of the investee company, not a portfolio allocation. Coverage is limited to individually disclosed public holdings.
limitations: Public named holdings are not a complete portfolio. Reporting thresholds and missing filings leave positions unobserved.
Secondary shareholder transcriptions are labelled reported; original exchange filings could not be retrieved in this review.
Review date differs from ownership date. Absence from a disclosure does not establish zero ownership or an exit.

The Singapore Ministry of Finance says Government assets are mainly managed by GIC, while Temasek owns its own assets. This profile follows the named Government of Singapore shareholder; it is not an additional independent pool to add to GIC or Temasek exposure.
